thesis: The site is the catch-cup audit itself: every section is a reading on the coverage grid, and scrolling fills the cups from empty to measured so the homeowner sees their yard quantified before anyone asks for money.

signature.name: coverage-grid
signature.summary: A 4x4 grid of cup outlines that fill to different levels via --sw-p as you scroll; recurs in hero (16 cups filling + uniformity count), services (single cup per card showing fix frequency), reviews (cards inside grid cells), prices (cup icon with fill matching price band), and footer (all 16 full). Hook: data-sw-signature='coverage-grid'.

palette.family: Lab Sheet + Gauge Blue + Fix Coral

motion.intro: 16 hero cups fill at staggered rates (60ms apart), uniformity number counts up beside them; h1 line-mask reveals in parallel; ≤1.2s, skippable.
stories: Audit report rows tick found→priced→fixed on scroll (pinned desktop ≥640px, stacked cards on phone)
Coverage grid in margin fills cup-by-cup as sections enter view via --sw-p
motion.hover: Hairline under items grows scaleX(0→1) from left, 200ms; one language everywhere.
